title: Pega Senior System Architect (SSA)
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Pega Senior System Architect (SSA)** with strong expertise in Pega architecture, BPM, BRE, solution design and enterprise technology delivery.

The candidate will be responsible for owning technical design, guiding development teams, ensuring Pega guardrail compliance, troubleshooting complex production issues and providing architecture guidance across multiple projects.

Roles \& ResponsibilitiesSolution Architecture \& Technology Delivery

* Facilitate, lead and participate in the identification of solution options and features for Pega applications.
* Communicate solution options to business owners, stakeholders and Architecture Review Boards.
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise technology standards, solution patterns, application frameworks, technology roadmaps and capital plans.
* Maintain awareness of existing technology assets and their capabilities.
* Deliver project deliverables within scope, timelines and required quality standards.
* Take ownership of end\-to\-end technology delivery.
* Act as the **Technical Design Authority** for multiple projects.
* Own design recommendations throughout the complete project lifecycle.

BPM \& BRE

* Provide cross\-segment and cross\-domain guidance on **BPM (Business Process Management)** and **BRE (Business Rules Engine)**.
* Provide technology recommendations and transition strategies for complex or multiple projects.
* Support the design, development and implementation of Pega initiatives.
* Act as a **BPM and Pega leader/mentor**.
* Propose innovative and out\-of\-the\-box solutions for complex business problems.

Quality Governance

* Ensure teams follow Pega development best practices.
* Ensure application configuration is compliant with **Pega guardrails**.
* Review the work of other team members and provide technical guidance.
* Support quality governance across Pega implementations.

Troubleshooting \& Performance

* Assist with troubleshooting and debugging complex systems.
* Identify root causes of production\-level architecture and application issues.
* Provide practical, evidence\-based technical recommendations.
* Review application logs to ensure quality standards.
* Run **Preflight and PAL** to assess performance and quality.
* Support performance optimization and architectural improvements.

Deployment

* Design and recommend effective deployment procedures.
* Support deployment planning across Pega environments.
* Ensure deployment processes align with enterprise standards and project requirements.

Required Pega Technical Knowledge

Candidates should have working knowledge of the following **PRPC design and implementation concepts**:

* Work Object Relationships
* Specialization Techniques
* Reporting
* Routing
* Skills\-based Routing
* Rule Resolution
* Inheritance
* Circumstancing
* Class Design
* Locking
* Persistence
* Authentication
* Agents
* Functions
* Java API
* Services
* Connectors
* Security and Access Controls

PRPC Architecture Knowledge

Strong understanding of:

* J2EE Architecture
* PRPC Multinode Architecture
* JVM
* PRPC Caching
* Session Management
* AJAX in PRPC
* Tracer
* DB Trace

Delivery \& Methodology

* Experience working in an **Agile/SCRUM** environment.
* Experience with **Pega Smart BPM software development lifecycle**.
* Experience working on complex enterprise Pega implementations.
* Ability to work across business, technology and architecture teams.

Mandatory Skills

* **Pega Senior System Architect (SSA)**
* **Pega CSSA Certification – Mandatory**
* Pega BPM
* BRE
* Pega Architecture
* Solution Design

* Pega Guardrails and development best practices

title: AI Architect
description:
India \- Bangalore


Professional Services/Full time/Onsite

  



Guidewire is seeking an AI Architect to join our Professional Services AI Engineering team in Bangalore. You will work horizontally across AI Engineering initiatives, helping blueprint AI features and define the patterns that allow Strike Teams to deliver production\-ready AI capabilities. Your primary craft is AI solution architecture — shaping the prompt engineering, harness engineering, RAG, evaluation, observability, and model\-selection approach that turns an AI idea into a reliable feature.  

  

You will help teams make data\-informed decisions about when to use agentic workflows, direct LLM calls, RAG, classical NLP/NLU, lightweight ML, or model fine\-tuning. You will mentor P2/P3 AI engineers, review designs, create reusable patterns, and help the broader team explain AI design choices clearly across Guidewire, SI partners, and customers.


**Job Description**


Key Responsibilities

* **AI Feature Blueprinting:** Create technical blueprints for AI features, including architecture, data needs, model strategy, evaluation approach, and delivery risks.
* **Model Selection:** Define patterns for identifying which LLM model should be used for each call, and when to use NLP/NLU instead.
* **Harness Architecture:** Shape reusable patterns for agent loops, tool/function calling, context construction, memory, structured outputs, retries, and failure handling.
* **Prompt Engineering:** Set standards for prompt design, versioning, review, experimentation, and regression testing as first\-class engineering assets.
* **Evaluation:** Design eval frameworks, golden datasets, regression suites, error analysis, and LLM\-as\-judge patterns to measure quality and guide decisions.
* R**AG \& Knowledge Patterns:** Guide document parsing, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, prompt assembly, and grounded response patterns.
* **Mentorship \& Enablement:** Coach P2/P3 AI engineers, review technical designs, create examples, and help junior engineers present architecture findings clearly.
* **Cross\-Guidewire Collaboration:** Partner with Product, AI CoE, PS, customer teams, and SI partners.

  

KPIs \& Success Metrics

  

* AI feature blueprints are clear, reusable, and actionable for Strike Teams.
* Model and architecture choices are backed by evals, analysis, and documented trade\-offs.
* Prompt, harness, RAG, and evaluation patterns are adopted consistently by P2/P3 engineers.
* Delivered AI features meet project bars for accuracy, groundedness, reliability, latency, and cost.
* Junior and mid\-level engineers can implement patterns and explain the results confidently.

  

Key Skills \& Experience

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* **Experience:** 8\+ years of experience in AI, machine learning, data science, software engineering, or solution architecture.
* **AI Architecture:** Strong ability to translate ambiguous product or delivery goals into practical AI system designs.
* **AI Fundamentals:** Deep understanding of LLMs, prompts, embeddings, retrieval, structured outputs, tool use, agentic workflows, and model failure modes.
* **NLP/NLU Judgment:** Able to recognize when classical NLP/NLU, rules\-based approaches, lightweight ML, or structured extraction are better than generative AI.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
	+ Strong Python/Java skills and ability to read, review, and contribute to production\-quality code.
	+ Experience designing LLM harnesses, including orchestration, tool/function calling, context construction, retries, and fallback behavior.
	+ Strong prompt engineering practice, including structured iteration, versioning, evaluation, and regression testing.
	+ Working knowledge of RAG patterns, embeddings, retrieval evaluation, and vector search concepts.
	+ Comfortable designing evaluation approaches using golden sets, regression suites, error taxonomies, and human review loops.
* **Engineering Excellence:** Familiar with Git, code review, testing, CI/CD concepts, cloud\-based delivery, and production engineering practices.
* **Communication \& Mentorship:** Able to explain complex AI trade\-offs clearly and coach less experienced engineers without direct reporting authority.

  

Preferred Skills \& Experience

* **Agentic AI Systems:** Experience with agentic frameworks or custom agent harnesses in production.
* Evals: Experience building structured eval harnesses, regression suites, LLM\-as\-judge patterns, or production feedback loops.
* **Cloud:** Hands\-on AWS experience with services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, OpenSearch, or related cloud\-native AI/data services.

title: Senior Engineer - Windows Platform & Packaging Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Windows Platform \& Packaging Engineer**


**Job Title:** Windows Platform \& Packaging Engineer (InstallShield / PowerShell)  

**Experience:** 6\-8 Years  

**Location:** Bangalore


**Role Summary**


We are looking for an experienced **Windows Platform \& Packaging Engineer** to support the migration and deployment of enterprise applications from Linux\-based environments to Windows platforms. The engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining Windows installation packages, deployment processes, automation scripts, and upgrade mechanisms using **InstallShield** and **PowerShell**. The role involves close collaboration with architects, development teams, DevOps, QA, and product teams to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable application deployment across Windows environments, including medical device platforms and Windows Server systems.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and maintain Windows installer packages using **InstallShield (MSI, EXE, Suite/Advanced UI Projects)**.
* Create deployment packages for **Java, .NET, and hybrid applications**, including native DLLs and third\-party dependencies.
* Convert and adapt Linux\-based installation, deployment, and upgrade processes for Windows environments.
* Develop and maintain **PowerShell scripts** for installation, configuration, deployment, upgrade, and maintenance automation.
* Configure and manage **Windows Services**, environment variables, registry settings, and system configurations required by applications.
* Implement and maintain application upgrade, patching, rollback, repair, and uninstallation mechanisms.
* Manage dependency installation, prerequisite validation, and silent/unattended deployments.
* Integrate installer creation and deployment activities with **CI/CD pipelines** and release management processes.
* Troubleshoot installer, deployment, configuration, and environment\-related issues across development, test, and production environments.
* Ensure installers comply with security, audit, logging, code\-signing, and enterprise deployment standards.
* Support deployment validation on Windows Server platforms and medical imaging/Ultrasound device environments.
* Collaborate with Development, QA, Architecture, and Release teams to streamline software delivery and deployment processes.
* Maintain technical documentation for installer architecture, deployment workflows, and release procedures.

**Required Skills \& Expertise**


**Packaging \& Installer Development**


* Strong hands\-on experience with **InstallShield** (Basic MSI, InstallScript, Suite/Advanced UI Projects).
* In\-depth knowledge of **Windows Installer (MSI/MSIX)** architecture and packaging concepts.
* Experience creating MSI, EXE, and Suite installers for enterprise software.
* Strong understanding of installer versioning, upgrades, patches, hotfixes, and rollback strategies.

**Windows Platform**


* Good knowledge of **Windows Server Administration**.
* Experience managing Windows Services, Registry, Environment Variables, File System permissions, and system configurations.
* Understanding of Windows deployment best practices and enterprise software distribution methods.

**Scripting \& Automation**


* Strong proficiency in **PowerShell scripting** (mandatory).
* Experience automating installation, deployment, validation, and maintenance activities.
* Familiarity with Batch scripting and deployment automation tools.

**Application Deployment**


* Experience packaging and deploying **Java and .NET applications**.
* Knowledge of native DLL management, third\-party dependencies, and prerequisite handling.
* Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills for installation and deployment issues.

**DevOps \& Release Engineering**


* Experience with **Git**, Azure Repos, or similar source control systems.
* Familiarity with **Azure DevOps, Jenkins**, or equivalent CI/CD platforms.
* Understanding of build automation and release engineering practices.

**Preferred Skills**


* Experience in **Linux\-to\-Windows migration projects**.
* Knowledge of **code signing and certificate management**.
* Experience with **InstallShield Suite / Advanced UI projects**.
* Familiarity with enterprise deployment tools such as **SCCM, Microsoft Intune**, or equivalent.
* Exposure to medical device, healthcare, or regulated software environments.
* Understanding of authentication, LDAP, and security\-related deployments.
* Experience with distributed applications, microservices, or containerized deployments.
* Knowledge of **WiX Toolset** and modern Windows packaging technologies.
* Basic to intermediate **.NET development** experience.

**Soft Skills**


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently in a cross\-functional environment.
* Strong collaboration skills across Development, QA, DevOps, Product, and Architecture teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliverables effectively.

title: Architect,Salesforce
description:

Consilio stands as the global leader in eDiscovery, document review, flexible legal talent, and legal advisory \& transformation consulting services. With its Consilio Complete suite of capabilities, the company empowers multinational law firms and corporations using innovative software, cost\-effective managed services, and deep legal and regulatory industry expertise.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Salesforce Architect to join our team in Bangalore. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Salesforce platform architecture, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and the broader Salesforce ecosystem. This role will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions by maximizing Salesforce out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) capabilities and strategically leveraging AppExchange solutions and third\-party plugins to meet business requirements. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, guiding platform strategy, governance, solution architecture, and enterprise\-wide Salesforce adoption.


Responsibilities:

Own and define the Salesforce architecture roadmap, ensuring alignment with enterprise technology and business strategies.  

  

Design scalable solutions leveraging Salesforce OOTB features and capabilities, including Flows, Dynamic Forms, Approval Processes, OmniStudio, Einstein AI, and Platform functionality before considering custom development.  

  

Evaluate, recommend, and implement Salesforce AppExchange applications, managed packages, and third\-party plugins to maximize business value while minimizing technical debt.  

  

Lead architecture and design sessions for Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and future Salesforce platform initiatives.  

  

Establish enterprise integration patterns and oversee integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST APIs, middleware solutions, and event\-driven architectures.  

  

Partner with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.  

  

Provide architectural leadership, governance, and mentorship to Salesforce Administrators, Developers, and Technical Leads.  

  

Drive platform optimization, security, data architecture, compliance, scalability, and performance best practices.  

  

Review and approve solution designs, ensuring adherence to Salesforce best practices, architectural standards, and long\-term maintainability.  

  

Support release management, environment strategy, and deployment governance in collaboration with DevOps and delivery teams.  

  

Ability to reverse engineer existing platform design and make recommendations to align with SalesForce OOTB best practices and configurations. **Requirements**  

10\+ years of progressive Salesforce experience, including significant experience in solution and platform architecture roles.  

  

Deep expertise across Salesforce platform capabilities, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Salesforce Platform.  

  

Proven experience designing and implementing solutions that maximize Salesforce OOTB functionality and reduce unnecessary customization.  

  

Strong experience evaluating, selecting, and implementing AppExchange applications, managed packages, and third\-party Salesforce ecosystem solutions.  

  

Expert understanding of Salesforce security architecture, sharing models, role hierarchies, permission sets, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements.  

  

Extensive experience designing enterprise integrations using REST APIs, middleware platforms, and integration best practices.  

  

Strong knowledge of Salesforce data architecture, master data management, large data volumes, and platform performance optimization.  

  

Working knowledge of Apex, SOQL, and Lightning Web Components (LWC) sufficient to guide technical design decisions and development teams.  

  

Experience leading technical teams and collaborating with executive stakeholders in Agile/Scrum environments.  

  

Experience in Github, JIRA, Confluence, and CI/CD tools such as Gearset.  

  

Salesforce Application Architect and/or Salesforce System Architect certifications required.  

  

Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification is highly preferred.
Qualifications:

Experience leading enterprise\-wide Salesforce transformation initiatives and multi\-cloud implementations.  

  

Knowledge of Salesforce Data Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and AI\-powered Salesforce capabilities.  

  

Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, governance models, and technology roadmaps.  

  

Experience with integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or similar technologies.  

  

Experience supporting global Salesforce organizations with complex business processes and large user communities. **Why Join Us:**

title: Sr Engineer - Cloud Enablement
description:
**About Us:**  



  

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world\-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.

 **Target Tech Overview:**


Every time a guest enters a Target store or browses Target.com, they experience the impact of Target’s investments in technology and innovation. We’re the technologists behind one of the most loved retail brands, delivering joy to millions of our guests, team members, and communities.

  

Our global in\-house technology team of more than 5,000 of engineers, data scientists, architects, coaches and product managers strive to make Target the most convenient, safe and joyful place to shop. We use agile practices and leverage open\-source software to adapt and build best\-in\-class technology for our team members and guests—and we do so with a focus on diversity and inclusion, experimentation and continuous learning.

 **Pyramid Overview:**


The Cloud Enablement team builds and operates the foundational public cloud platform that engineering teams across Target rely on to deliver at enterprise scale. Working primarily on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), the team owns a hardened, standardized cloud foundation spanning compute, Kubernetes, storage, networking, and identity — the core building blocks that power Target's digital and data\-driven experiences. Our mission is to make cloud simple, secure, and cost\-effective to consume: we design the opinionated patterns, policies, and guardrails that keep workloads safe and reliable, and we build the APIs, automation, and self\-service tooling that let teams adopt and scale cloud services with confidence. Following an infrastructure\-as\-code philosophy, we treat repeatability, resilience, and security as first\-class engineering outcomes rather than afterthoughts. We partner closely with platform and product teams to onboard new workloads, drive cloud cost stewardship, and continuously raise the bar on operational excellence, availability, and readiness for our highest\-traffic events. As a lead engineer on this team, you'll help shape cloud strategy, architect platform capabilities and tooling, and set technical direction that multiplies the productivity of engineers across the company — a high\-impact role at the center of how Target builds in the cloud.

  

As a Senior Engineer on the Cloud Enablement team, you'll contribute:

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Design, build, deploy, and support scalable cloud platform capabilities using cloud services, preferably **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, with a strong focus on reliability, security, automation, and developer experience in **Golang.**
* Implement cloud engineering best practices across resource provisioning, configuration management, monitoring, observability, security, governance, and cost optimization.
* Develop and maintain cloud infrastructure and platform services using **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** technologies to automate infrastructure deployment and configuration.
* Build and maintain APIs, automation services, and operational tooling that simplify cloud operations and improve engineering productivity.
* Drive continuous improvement by adopting and advancing automation, orchestration, **GitOps, self\-service tooling, and reusable platform patterns**.
* Apply your technical expertise and stay current with emerging technologies and practices across cloud computing, Kubernetes, platform engineering, and DevOps.
* Evaluate new technologies and contribute to technical decision\-making. Initiate and execute research and proof\-of\-concept activities to assess new technologies and approaches.
* Provide technical guidance for both routine and complex engineering challenges, including troubleshooting issues across cloud infrastructure, networking, IAM, CI/CD, observability, monitoring, logging, and tracing. Escalate issues when appropriate.
* Participate in complex design, construction, automation, migration, and implementation initiatives, ensuring solutions meet architectural, security, compliance, and operational requirements.
* Establish and evolve engineering standards and best practices for monitoring, testing, automation, security, and maintenance of cloud platform components, infrastructure services, and shared engineering capabilities.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the organization’s technical capabilities, cloud infrastructure, platform services, and broader technology environment.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Four\-year degree or equivalent practical experience.
* **6\+ years of experience** in software development **(Golang),** cloud engineering **(Google Cloud),** platform engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or infrastructure engineering, with a focus on cloud services.
* Strong domain knowledge of cloud platforms, including **account/project management, compute, storage, databases, networking, serverless technologies, IAM, security, observability, and cost management**.
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as **Terraform, Pulumi, Crossplane**, or similar tools.
* Experience developing **APIs, automation, and operational tooling** using **Golang, Python, and Bash scripting**.
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies including **Docker, Kubernetes**, and managed Kubernetes platforms such as **Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)**.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and tracing technologies such as **OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Google Cloud Operations, Splunk, Datadog**, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with Linux environments, virtual machines, containers, networking, DNS, load balancing, and cloud\-native runtime environments.
* Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with project teams, application teams, partners, and stakeholders.
* Strong expertise in analyzing and optimizing **system capacity, performance, reliability, scalability, security, and operational health**.
* Experience building **highly scalable distributed systems, internal developer platforms, automation frameworks, or shared cloud platform services**.

title: Senior FI Specialist
description:
Role Description:

Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is a global powerhouse in online travel, connecting millions of people with unforgettable experiences in over 220 countries and territories. With a market value of approximately $120 billion and a diverse portfolio of brands such as Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com and OpenTable, we’re committed to making it easier to explore everyone to experience the world.


Booking Holdings Bangalore is a cutting\-edge Center of Excellence in Bangalore, India and a key arm of Booking Holdings Inc. Top talent from diverse backgrounds converge here to develop innovative solutions that drive Booking Holdings' brands and business units forward. We offer a vibrant and inclusive workplace that fosters creativity, growth and opportunities to make a real difference on a global scale.

  

From bustling cities to remote corners, Booking Holdings' travel brands span 220\+ countries. Our FinTech team powers the financial engine behind this global network. We craft bespoke payment solutions, blending security with scalability. These tools empower our partners, fueling their growth and enhancing traveler experiences. By supporting our partners' success, we strengthen the foundation of our diverse travel ecosystem.

  

We are seeking a seasoned **Senior FI Specialist** **(IC Role)** with 15\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance (FICO) and enterprise architecture. Operating as a lead technical authority and individual contributor, you will drive the architectural blueprint, end\-to\-end solution design, and technical delivery of enterprise\-scale Record\-to\-Report (R2R) platforms.


This role requires deep functional and technical expertise in SAP S/4HANA, high\-volume transactional integrations (specifically with BRIM), and modern enterprise financial platforms. You will serve as the primary bridge between Finance leadership, Product Managers, Technical Architects, and System Integrators (SIs), shaping the future of our financial tech stack, safeguarding North Star Architecture (NSA) principles, and ensuring zero\-defect accounting compliance across complex ERP transformation programs (including RISE with SAP).

**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

#### **1\. Architectural Leadership \& Engineering Excellence**

* **Solution Architecture Ownership:** Own the end\-to\-end architecture and solution design for SAP S/4HANA Finance (R2R) across all project phases (Explore, Realize, Deploy, Hypercare), ensuring strict alignment between core accounting principles, business requirements, and system scalability.
* **Core FICO Domain Expertise:** Drive design authority across core domains:


	+ General Ledger (GL): Universal Journal (ACDOCA), parallel ledgers, document splitting, multi\-currency frameworks, and financial close automation.
	+ Asset Accounting (AA): Asset lifecycle management, multi\-GAAP depreciation areas, and integration workflows.
	+ Subledger Accounting (AP/AR \& FICA): Business Partner and Contract Account master data, posting areas, main/sub configurations, payment processing, and open\-item clearing.
	+ Intercompany Accounting: Cross\-entity netting, intercompany settlement routing, and period\-end elimination matching.
	+ Managerial Accounting (CO): Cost/Profit Center accounting, internal orders, margin analysis, and managerial reporting.
* **ABAP \& Technical Oversight:** Conduct deep\-code reviews, debugging, and root\-cause analysis. Guide engineering teams on SAP programming best practices, performance tuning, and database optimization (ACDOCA/HANA views).
* **WRICEF Governance \& Clean Core:** Review and validate WRICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms) objects. Drive strict "Clean Core" standardization vs. customization decisions to minimize technical debt and avoid unnecessary custom builds.
* **Design Governance \& Quality Control:** Review and sign off on Solution Design Documents (SDDs), Enterprise Structure Key Design Decisions (KDDs), and L3–L5 process maps. Ensure all designs meet strict audit readiness, SOX controls, and financial compliance standards.

#### **2\. Enterprise Integrations \& Ecosystem Orchestration**

* **BRIM Integration:** Drive deep integration designs between FI and SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) to ensure compliant order\-to\-cash, billing ingestion, and revenue accounting (IFRS 15\) flows.
* **Ecosystem Connectivity:** Architect robust integration patterns connecting SAP with third\-party and ecosystem platforms, including BlackLine (Intercompany Hub, SOX Certifications, Multi\-Source Reconciliations), OneStream/FinDB, Snowflake data lakes, and custom middleware (MuleSoft API gateways).
* **Reconciliation Integrity:** Validate end\-to\-end data pipelines (Subledger \-\>GL \-\> Reporting platforms), ensuring complete financial reconciliation, zero data loss, and zero breaks in double\-entry accounting logic.

#### **3\. SAP Transformation \& RISE Implementation**

* **RISE Execution:** Serve as the lead technical authority on large\-scale programs such as RISE with SAP / S/4HANA transformation programs across Explore, Realize, Deploy, and Hypercare phases.
* **System Integrator (SI) Challenge:** Partner closely with System Integrators to validate, guide, and challenge proposed solutions, stopping rigid template\-driven approaches that do not fit the enterprise's long\-term architectural vision.
* **Migration \& Cutover:** Oversee financial data migration strategies, cutover plans, parallel\-run validations, and testing frameworks (SIT/UAT) from a technical finance standpoint.

#### **4\. Strategic Influence \& Stakeholder Management**

* **Cross\-Track Alignment:** Act as an individual contributor thought\-leader and bridge between Finance, Engineering, Product Management, and external partners, translating complex business requirements into elegant system behaviors.
* **Domain Mentorship:** Foster internal engineering/architectural capability by mentoring junior/mid\-level engineers and architects on SAP S/4HANA best practices, integration patterns, and emerging technologies (e.g., AI/automation in month\-end financial closing).

#### **5\. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**

* **Financial Process Automation \& AI:** Evaluate, architect, and prototype emerging automation technologies, including AI/ML use cases for intelligent anomaly detection, Business Process Automation, Document AI, automated cash application, AI\-assisted month\-end close (MEC) forecasting, and robotic process automation (RPA), to reduce manual finance effort and improve reporting accuracy.
* **Architecture Evolution \& "Clean Core"**: Continually assess technical debt across our SAP and connected ecosystems. Proactively design refactoring plans to decouple legacy custom code, migrating toward SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services, standard APIs, and "Clean Core" extensibility patterns.
* **Benchmarking \& Tooling Optimization:** Research industry best practices and stay ahead of the curve on vendor roadmaps (SAP S/4HANA releases, RISE updates, BlackLine innovations, BRIM enhancements). Identify opportunities to replace expensive custom builds with native out\-of\-the\-box system capabilities.
* **Engineering Thought Leadership:** Act as a catalyst for continuous improvement within the engineering track by introducing automated testing frameworks for SAP, CI/CD pipeline enhancements for transport manager

**What You’ll Be Bringing**
---------------------------

* **Experience:** 15\+ years of progressive experience in SAP Finance (FI/CO), with at least 7\+ years in solution architecture, lead engineering, or technical authority roles.
* **Role Focus:** Proven track record as a high\-impact Individual Contributor capable of driving architectural consensus without direct line management authority.
* **S/4HANA Expertise:** Successfully delivered 2 to 4 end\-to\-end S/4HANA greenfield/brownfield implementations or global rollouts, including international localization and multi\-gap tax/regulatory requirements.
* **Integration Track Record:** Hands\-on experience architecting FI integrations with SAP BRIM (Billing, Convergent Invoicing, FICA) and external subledgers/billing platforms.
* **Transformation Experience:** Direct architectural leadership in at least one full lifecycle RISE with SAP or S/4HANA Cloud deployment.
* **Technical Depth:** Expert\-level capability in analyzing custom ABAP code, debugging standard/custom SAP flows, designing complex APIs/interfaces, and structuring custom data models.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep familiarity with financial closing and reconciliation platforms such as BlackLine (ICH, Matching, Close Management) or OneStream.
* Strong understanding of modern reporting layers (SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BTP, BI/BW, Snowflake).
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum product management methodologies in enterprise software tracks.
* Exposure to financial process automation, machine learning in cash application, or AI\-driven anomaly detection in financial close operations.

**Where You’ll Be**
-------------------

title: Senior Product Support Engineer
description:
**Senior Product Support Engineer**
Development \+ Technical Support**Experience:** 5–7 years**Function:** Product Engineering / Customer Success**Employment type:** Full\-time**Location:** \[Bangalore / Hybrid / Remote]**Reports to:** \[Manager, Technical Support / Head of Engineering]**About the role**
==================


This is a hybrid engineering and support role for someone who is equally comfortable debugging a customer’s production issue and writing the code that stops it happening again.
You will be the senior technical escalation point for our product across heterogeneous customer environments Windows, Linux and Solaris, integrated with enterprise Active Directory, SIEM platforms and a range of network infrastructure. Roughly half your time will be spent on deep troubleshooting and customer\-facing escalation; the other half on building fixes, tooling, integrations and automation that reduce future ticket volume.
We are looking for someone who treats a recurring support ticket as a defect to be engineered away, not a queue to be worked through.**What you will do**
====================

**Troubleshooting and escalation**
----------------------------------

* Own Level 3 escalations end to endreproduce, diagnose root cause, and drive to resolution across OS, network, database and application layers
* Analyse logs, packet captures, stack traces, core dumps and performance counters to isolate faults in complex multi\-vendor environments
* Diagnose issues spanning customer infrastructure boundaries: authentication, directory services, firewalls, proxies, certificates and network policy
* Work directly with customer IT, security and infrastructure teams, including during high\-severity incidents
* Produce clear root cause analysis documents for customer and internal audiences

**Development**
---------------

* Build and ship fixes, patches and product improvements in C\# and Python
* Develop diagnostic tooling, log analysers, health\-check scripts and automated reproduction harnesses
* Write and optimise SQL for investigation, data correction and performance analysis
* Build and maintain customer\-facing integrationsActive Directory, SIEM connectors, APIs and data pipelines
* Contribute to product hardening: instrumentation, logging quality, error handling and observability

**Deployment and integration**
------------------------------

* Support installation, upgrade and configuration of the product across Windows Server, Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu) and Solaris
* Configure and troubleshoot Active Directory / LDAP integration, Kerberos, SSO and certificate\-based authentication
* Integrate product telemetry and event data with customer SIEM platforms
* Support cloud and hybrid deployments, including containerised environments

**Knowledge and enablement**
----------------------------

* Maintain runbooks, knowledge base articles and troubleshooting guides
* Mentor junior support engineers and act as a technical reviewer on complex tickets
* Feed recurring issues and field insight back into the product roadmap

**Required skills and experience**
==================================

**Experience**
--------------

* 5–7 years in a combined engineering and technical support capacity, supporting an enterprise software product deployed in customer environments
* Demonstrable history of resolving complex, cross\-system production issues

**Operating systems**
---------------------

* Strong administration and troubleshooting on Linux (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu) systemd, journald, permissions, process and resource analysis, package management
* Windows Server administration — services, Event Viewer, registry, PowerShell, IIS, performance monitoring
* Working knowledge of Solaris or another commercial UNIX in a legacy enterprise context
* Shell scripting (Bash, PowerShell)

**Identity and security**
-------------------------

* Hands\-on Active Directory integration: LDAP/LDAPS, Kerberos, group policy, service accounts, delegation, trusts
* Experience integrating applications with SIEM platforms (Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, Microsoft Sentinel or equivalent) — log forwarding, syslog, CEF/LEEF, event normalisation
* Practical understanding of TLS/PKI, certificate management and common certificate failure modes

**Networking**
--------------

* Solid grounding in TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, NAT, firewalls, load balancers and proxies
* Ability to read and interpret packet captures (Wireshark, tcpdump) to isolate connectivity and latency issues

**Development**
---------------

* Proficient in C\# / .NET
* Proficient in Python for automation, tooling and data processing
* Comfortable with Git, code review and CI/CD pipelines
* Ability to read unfamiliar production code and trace a fault to its source

**Database**
------------

* Strong SQL against at least one of SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle or MySQL
* Query performance analysis, indexing, execution plans, backup/restore, and basic administration

**Cloud**
---------

* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP) — compute, networking, identity, storage and managed database services
* Familiarity with containerised deployment (Docker; Kubernetes an advantage)
* Understanding of hybrid architectures where product components span on\-premises and cloud

**Desirable**
=============

* Experience with email infrastructure and protocolsIMAP, SMTP, Exchange/EWS, Microsoft Graph
* Exposure to machine learning or classification systems in a production support context
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) and observability tooling (Grafana, ELK, Prometheus)
* Certifications: RHCE/RHCSA, Microsoft (Azure Administrator, Identity and Access Administrator), AWS Solutions Architect, CCNA, Security\+
* Experience supporting regulated customers — financial services, healthcare or public sector
* Familiarity with ITIL incident, problem and change management

**What we look for beyond the checklist**
=========================================

* **Structured diagnostic thinking.** You form hypotheses and test them rather than changing settings until something works.
* **Comfort with ambiguity.** Enterprise environments are undocumented and inconsistent; you find your own way in.
* **Customer\-grade communication.** You can explain a Kerberos delegation failure to a CISO and to a junior admin, correctly, in the same afternoon.
* **Composure under pressure.** You are calm and credible on a Severity 1 bridge call.
* **A bias toward permanent fixes.** You are more interested in the third occurrence never happening than in closing the ticket quickly.

title: Associate - Pipeline Design (Water & Wastewater)
description:
Suitable candidate for this role is a Civil Design Engineer with proven experience in the design and delivery of buried pipeline infrastructure for water, wastewater and stormwater projects. The role requires a strong understanding of pipeline alignment development, hydraulic design and the detailed design of associated civil structures. The successful candidate will be proficient in Autodesk Civil 3D and capable of developing three\-dimensional pipe networks, long sections and coordinated designs that integrate hydraulic, utility, operational and construction requirements.


  
* The candidate should have experience designing horizontal and vertical pipeline alignments to satisfy hydraulic performance criteria while minimising utility conflicts and construction risks.
* They will be familiar with hydraulic principles relevant to gravity and pressure pipeline systems, including Manning's equation, Colebrook\-White analysis, hydraulic grade line development, shear stress assessment and self\-cleansing velocity requirements.
* A sound understanding of pipe material selection is required, including the relative advantages, limitations and application of PVC, PE, GRP, steel and concrete pipe systems.
* Experience in developing general arrangement drawings and detailed layouts for manholes, hydraulic control structures, valve chambers, maintenance access arrangements and other pipeline appurtenances.
* The candidate should be able to apply operational, maintenance, safety and constructability considerations when developing these designs.
* Knowledge of structural design requirements for buried pipelines is desirable, including familiarity with flexible pipe design principles in accordance with AS/NZS 2566 and rigid concrete pipe design in accordance with AS/NZS 3725\.
* Produce reports and presentations at high levels of professional and technical calibre suitable for presenting to clients.
* Apply sound engineering judgement and best practices to arrive at technical decisions that drive innovative, fit\-for\-purpose and value\-engineered solutions to meet project and client needs.

description:

**Good to have skills :** NA

We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Architect to lead the definition, design, deployment, and documentation of secure, scalable, and resilient technical environments, with a primary focus on Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops. The role will evaluate architecture options, establish technical standards, define governance and testing criteria, and ensure that solutions align with business objectives, operational requirements, security controls, and cost considerations. Lead the architecture, design, deployment, and lifecycle management of Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops environments.  

Develop solution architectures, architectural standards, design documents, implementation patterns, and operational procedures.

Define architecture governance, conformance processes, solution\-testing criteria, and acceptance standards.  

Design high\-availability and disaster\-recovery capabilities for business\-critical virtual application and desktop services.  

Collaborate with cloud, network, security, workplace, application, and operations teams to ensure end\-to\-end solution integration.  

Provide technical leadership, make team\-level decisions, and contribute to key decisions across multiple teams.  

Serve as the escalation point for complex architecture, performance, availability, and security issues.  

Facilitate knowledge sharing, coach team members, and mentor technical leads to strengthen delivery capability.  

Evaluate emerging technologies, tools, and automation opportunities that improve efficiency, reliability, and user experience.  

Communicate architectural direction, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to technical and business stakeholders.  

  

Required Technical Skills:  

  

Strong expertise in Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops architecture, design, implementation, and optimization.  

Strong understanding of virtualization, cloud computing, hybrid infrastructure, and enterprise application delivery.  

Experience with core Citrix components and supporting technologies, including StoreFront, Delivery Controllers, Citrix Director, Machine Creation Services or Provisioning Services, Citrix Workspace, and Citrix ADC.  

Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, identity and access management, and profile management.  

Strong knowledge of network architecture, load balancing, connectivity, certificates, and infrastructure security best practices.  

Ability to design scalable, highly available, resilient, and recoverable infrastructure solutions.  

Experience in capacity planning, performance monitoring, root\-cause analysis, upgrades, patching, and platform lifecycle management.  

Familiarity with automation and scripting, such as PowerShell, to streamline deployment and operational activities.  

Ability to produce clear architecture diagrams, high\-level and low\-level designs, standards, and operating documentation.  

Preferred Skills  

Experience integrating Citrix solutions with public cloud platforms and hybrid environments.  

Knowledge of Zero Trust principles, endpoint security, monitoring, and IT service management practices.  

Relevant Citrix, cloud, Microsoft, virtualization, security, or IT service management certifications.  

Experience supporting large\-scale, multi\-site, or global enterprise environments.  

  

Leadership and Professional Capabilities:  

  

Demonstrated ability to operate as a subject matter expert and trusted technical advisor.  

Strong analytical, problem\-solving, decision\-making, and stakeholder\-management skills.  

Ability to lead technical discussions, manage competing priorities, and drive decisions to closure.  

Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business\-relevant outcomes.  

Collaborative leadership style with a strong focus on accountability, mentoring, and continuous improvement.  

  

Experience and Education:  

  

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops architecture.  

15 years of full\-time education.  

Role is based in Bengaluru.

title: Software Engineering Lead
description:
**About Airbound**
------------------

**Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.**


This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.


The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground\-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.


To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.

**About Flight Systems**
------------------------


The hardware on the drone is only half of what keeps it up in the air. The rest is the software both on the craft and on our ground station. Our unique dual motor thrust vectored tailsitter with blended wing body design has to fly in almost all weather\-including heavy winds and light rains autonomously. We're targeting 1000s of flights per day across all locations, requiring us to rethink everything from firmware, controls, state estimation to even ground control and fleet management software. We've achieved an industry\-leading payload\-to\-weight ratio of \~2kg drone for 1kg payload and we're pushing this even further. Every gram matters when you're revolutionizing logistics. This is where cutting\-edge aerospace engineering meets software scalability meets real\-world impact. If you get excited about solving problems that span multiple disciplines that don't have textbook solutions, this is your playground.

**About the Role**
------------------


We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Engineer to join our team dedicated to developing a suite of sophisticated, web\-based platforms for UAV operations. This role is central to building the software that powers our entire ecosystem, including our next\-generation Ground Control Station (GCS), fleet management dashboards, data analysis tools, and simulation interfaces. This position is integral to our core mission, contributing directly to the safety and efficiency of our real\-world autonomous operations.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Platform Development:** Architect, develop, and deploy robust, end\-to\-end features across our various web\-based UAV platforms
* **Front\-End Engineering:** Construct dynamic and highly responsive user interfaces using React for the visualization of real\-time telemetry, interactive mission planning, and complex data analysis
* **Back\-End Engineering:** Engineer high\-throughput, low\-latency backend services using NestJS to reliably process UAV data streams, manage command\-and\-control logic, and parse specialized communication protocols
* **Full Lifecycle Ownership:** Actively participate in all phases of the agile software development lifecycle (SDLC), from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance
* **Software Excellence:** Champion and adhere to software development best practices, including Test\-Driven Development (TDD), to ensure exceptional code quality, system reliability, and performance in a mission\-critical environment
* **Technical Documentation:** Create and maintain clear, concise technical documentation for the systems and features you develop, including architectural diagrams, API specifications, and operational runbooks
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work with cross\-functional teams to translate complex requirements into robust technical solutions

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Must\-Have**
--------------

* A minimum of 7\+ years of professional experience in full\-stack software development, preferably with exposure to real\-time systems
* Front\-End Technologies: Advanced proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React, with demonstrated experience building complex, data\-driven user interfaces
* Back\-End Technologies: Advanced proficiency in backend development with Node.js and extensive hands\-on experience with the NestJS framework
* Database Systems: Hands\-on experience with both SQL (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB) databases, including schema design and query optimization
* Networking: A strong understanding of core networking principles, including the TCP/IP suite and UDP, with practical experience implementing real\-time communication using WebSockets
* Data Stream Processing: Experience developing systems that process and manage continuous, high\-frequency data streams
* Software Engineering Fundamentals:


	+ Strong test\-driven development and profiling expertise for safety\-critical systems
	+ Mastery of Git workflows and collaborative development practices
	+ Application of SOLID principles and embedded software best practices
	+ Excellent documentation and communication skills for cross\-functional collaboration

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Domain Knowledge: Experience with UAV software like ArduPilot, simulation environments (SITL), and communication protocols like MAVLink
* Data Visualization: Proficiency with libraries such as D3\.js, Chart.js, Mapbox, or Leaflet
* Data Pipelines: Familiarity with message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka) or time\-series databases (e.g., InfluxDB, TimescaleDB)
* Additional Languages: Familiarity with C\+\+ or Python

**Work location:** Hoskote, Bangalore (Headquarters)

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Comprehensive health insurance** to keep you and your loved ones covered
* **Relocation assistance and a daily travel stipend** to ease your commute
* **Advanced salary credit** to support you when you need it


“A driven, passionate team where you’ll have room to grow and thrive \- **this is more than just a job, it’s a rare opportunity to build something meaningful** from the ground up”

**Work Schedule:**
------------------

* In\-office role, working alternate Saturdays.

**Ready to take off?**
======================

**About Airbound**
------------------

**Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.**


This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.


The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground\-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.


To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.

**About Flight Systems**
------------------------


The hardware on the drone is only half of what keeps it up in the air. The rest is the software both on the craft and on our ground station. Our unique dual motor thrust vectored tailsitter with blended wing body design has to fly in almost all weather\-including heavy winds and light rains autonomously. We're targeting 1000s of flights per day across all locations, requiring us to rethink everything from firmware, controls, state estimation to even ground control and fleet management software. We've achieved an industry\-leading payload\-to\-weight ratio of \~2kg drone for 1kg payload and we're pushing this even further. Every gram matters when you're revolutionizing logistics. This is where cutting\-edge aerospace engineering meets software scalability meets real\-world impact. If you get excited about solving problems that span multiple disciplines that don't have textbook solutions, this is your playground.

**About the Role**
------------------


In this critical, hands\-on engineering role, you will architect and deliver the complete avionics hardware stack that powers our revolutionary aircraft. You will own the entire hardware lifecycle from system architecture and EMI/EMC\-compliant PCB design to vendor management and high\-volume manufacturing with EMS partners, ensuring every board meets the rigorous demands of autonomous flight operations.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Avionics System Architecture:** Define and evolve the complete avionics architecture for our dual\-motor thrust\-vectored tailsitter
* **Power Electronics Design:** Design robust power management and distribution systems including DC\-DC converters, battery management, motor controllers, and protection circuits
* **RF \& Communication Systems:** Develop RF subsystems for telemetry, command \& control, and positioning. Ensure reliable long\-range communication in complex RF environments while maintaining compliance with regulatory standards
* **EMI/EMC Compliant PCB Design:** Create production\-ready PCBs with rigorous EMI/EMC design practices including proper grounding, shielding, trace routing, and component placement
* **Manufacturing \& Vendor Management:** Lead hardware productization from prototype to high\-volume manufacturing
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Collaborate closely with firmware, flight controls, and mechanical teams to ensure seamless hardware\-software integration. Drive technical decisions across teams, mentor junior engineers, and establish hardware development processes and best practices

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Must\-Have**
--------------

* 5\+ years in hardware/avionics engineering with a proven track record in complex embedded systems, preferably in aerospace, robotics, automotive, or high\-reliability applications. Demonstrated experience scaling custom hardware from prototype to volume production (1000\+ units)
* PCB Design \& Development: Expert\-level proficiency in schematic capture and PCB layout using tools like Altium Designer, KiCAD, or Cadence Allegro. Strong understanding of high\-speed digital design, mixed\-signal layouts, multi\-layer stackup design, and design for manufacturing (DFM) principles
* Power Electronics Expertise:


	+ Hands\-on experience designing switch\-mode power supplies, linear regulators, battery management systems, and motor control circuits
	+ Understanding of magnetics design, thermal management, and efficiency optimization
	+ Proficiency with power simulation tools (LTspice, PLECS, or similar)
* Embedded Systems \& Integration:


	+ Experience interfacing with microcontrollers and embedded Linux systems via I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, and Ethernet
	+ Knowledge of sensor integration (IMUs, GPS, barometers, cameras) and actuation systems
	+ Familiarity with embedded firmware development for hardware bring\-up and validation
* EMI/EMC \& Compliance:


	+ Practical knowledge of EMI/EMC design principles and testing methodologies
	+ Experience with relevant standards: MIL\-STD\-461, IEC 61000 series, FCC Part 15, DO\-160
	+ Understanding of shielding, filtering, grounding, and RF containment techniques
* RF Systems (Basic to Intermediate):


	+ Experience with RF communication systems (LoRa, LTE, 2\.4/5\.8 GHz ISM bands, GPS/GNSS)
	+ Understanding of antenna theory, impedance matching, and S\-parameters
	+ Proficiency with RF measurement equipment (VNA, spectrum analyzer, signal generator)
* Manufacturing \& Production:


	+ Proven experience managing EMS vendors and contract manufacturers
	+ Strong knowledge of PCB fabrication processes, assembly techniques (SMT, through\-hole, conformal coating), and quality control
	+ Experience with design for test (DFT), bring\-up procedures, and production test automation
	+ Understanding of supply chain management, component sourcing, and cost optimization
* Engineering Fundamentals:


	+ Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with hands\-on debugging expertise
	+ Proficiency with lab equipment: oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, power analyzers, thermal cameras
	+ Mastery of Git workflows for hardware version control and collaborative development
	+ Excellent documentation skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts across teams

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience with FPGA/CPLD design for high\-speed interfaces or custom signal processing
* Knowledge of DO\-254 processes for airborne electronic hardware certification
* Familiarity with environmental testing standards (vibration, shock, thermal cycling, altitude, humidity) and qualification processes for aerospace applications
* Experience with motor controller design and field\-oriented control (FOC) implementations
* Hands\-on experience with EMI/EMC testing in certified labs and driving design changes based on test results
* Background in wireless charging, inductive power transfer, or high\-power density converters
* Experience with safety\-critical systems design and failure mode analysis (FMEA, DFMEA)

**Work location:** Hoskote, Bangalore (Headquarters)

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.


**At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.**


**Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.**


**Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.**


**About the team and role**
---------------------------


**Our NuData team at eBay brings together exceptional engineers who are pushing the boundaries of distributed systems to build the next generation of database platforms powering eBay’s global marketplace. NuData builds and operates petabyte\-scale, highly available distributed data platforms supporting some of eBay’s most critical workloads.**


**We are seeking an experienced** **Senior Member of Technical Staff (Senior MTS)** **to join the NuData team in** **Bengaluru****. This individual will be a key technical contributor and hands\-on engineering leader for the local team, partnering closely with NuData architects, technical leads, and engineers in the** **U.S., China, and Ireland****.**


**In this role, you will help design and build critical capabilities across NuData’s distributed database platforms. You will own complex technical initiatives, contribute to key architectural decisions, and solve challenging problems involving scalability, availability, performance, consistency, and operational efficiency.**


**This is a** **hands\-on technical role****. You will stay deeply engaged with the technology—designing and implementing critical components, writing and reviewing production code, prototyping new approaches, debugging complex system and production issues, and working alongside engineers to solve challenging distributed\-systems problems. You will also engage directly with NuData customers to understand their workloads, address technical challenges, and ensure our platforms continue to meet their evolving needs.**


**You will also contribute to strengthening NuData’s engineering organization in Bengaluru by mentoring engineers, raising the technical bar, promoting strong engineering practices, and sharing expertise across the team.**


**What you will accomplish**
----------------------------


* **Own and drive major technical initiatives** **within NuData, contributing to the architecture and evolution of eBay’s distributed database platforms.**
* **Take end\-to\-end ownership of critical distributed database components and capabilities—from design and implementation through testing, production rollout, and ongoing operational excellence.**
* **Remain** **hands\-on with design and development****, implementing critical database components and production\-quality code while tackling complex problems across storage, transactions, replication, consensus, geo\-distribution, and high\-concurrency systems.**
* **Contribute to architectural decisions for complex technical problems, evaluating tradeoffs and developing pragmatic solutions that meet platform, customer, and business requirements.**
* **Drive improvements in scalability, latency, availability, reliability, and infrastructure efficiency across systems operating at eBay scale.**
* **Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, helping improve engineering judgment, technical skills, and overall engineering quality within the Bengaluru organization.**
* **Advocate for high standards in architecture, design, code quality, testing, observability, automation, and operational readiness. Participate in and lead design and code reviews for significant platform capabilities.**
* **Partner closely with engineers, architects, engineering leaders, product managers, and** **NuData customers** **to understand workloads, requirements, and technical challenges and translate them into effective platform solutions.**
* **Drive projects from early exploration through production—including brainstorming, prototyping, benchmarking, design, implementation, deployment, and production support.**
* **Evaluate emerging technologies and open\-source solutions and identify opportunities to improve NuData’s architecture and capabilities. Leverage AI\-assisted engineering tools where they improve engineering velocity and quality.**
* **Communicate technical designs, architectural decisions, and tradeoffs clearly to engineers, architects, and engineering leadership.**

**What you will bring**
-----------------------


* **Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field with 10\+ years of experience or a PhD with equivalent experience building large\-scale distributed systems.**
* **Significant hands\-on experience designing, building, and operating** **large\-scale distributed databases, storage systems, or data infrastructure****, with demonstrated ownership of technically complex systems and initiatives.**

### **Core Technical Expertise**


* **Strong expertise in distributed systems and database architecture, including distributed consensus, replication, consistency models, partitioning, fault tolerance, high availability, and geo\-distributed systems.**
* **Strong understanding of database internals such as storage and buffer management, write\-ahead logging (WAL), multi\-version concurrency control (MVCC), lock management, query planning/execution, indexing, and database engines.**
* **Strong transaction\-management expertise, including isolation levels, concurrency control, deadlock detection, crash recovery, physical/logical replication, and HA/failover strategies.**
* **Strong understanding of distributed\-system failure modes, including network partitions, partial failures, consensus protocols such as** **RAFT/PAXOS****, and the tradeoffs required to maintain availability, consistency, and performance at scale.**
* **Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, networking, operating systems, and software architecture.**
* **Advanced programming experience in one or more languages such as** **C\+\+, Java, Python, Scala****, or equivalent languages, with a track record of developing and debugging complex production systems.**
* **Extensive hands\-on experience with Object\-Oriented Design, distributed programming, and large\-scale relational and/or NoSQL database systems.**
* **Experience with modern infrastructure technologies and cloud\-native environments, including technologies such as** **Kubernetes and Docker****.**
* **Demonstrated ability to diagnose difficult production issues across software, storage, networking, and distributed\-system boundaries and drive problems through root cause and long\-term resolution.**

### **Technical Leadership \& Collaboration**


* **Demonstrated ability to** **provide technical leadership for significant components and projects****, contribute to architectural direction, and make sound technical tradeoffs.**
* **Proven ability to lead technically complex initiatives spanning multiple components and collaborate effectively across teams.**
* **Ability to operate at multiple levels—from designing systems and reviewing architecture to writing code, debugging production systems, and helping engineers solve difficult implementation problems.**
* **Strong track record of mentoring engineers, raising engineering standards, and contributing to a culture of technical excellence.**
* **Ability to produce clear, high\-quality architecture and design documents and drive alignment around important technical decisions.**
* **Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers, architects, engineering leaders, product teams, customers, and other stakeholders.**
* **Proven ability to navigate complex technical tradeoffs and build consensus across globally distributed teams.**
* **Demonstrated proficiency building** **production\-grade software with AI coding agents****, improving engineering velocity while maintaining high standards for quality, availability, and maintainability.**
* **Ability to** **decompose problems and provide agents with the right context, specifications, constraints, and validation criteria****.**
* **Ability to** **capture and express business, architecture, codebase, and operational knowledge** **so AI coding agents can execute complex engineering tasks accurately.**
* **Hands\-on experience delivering** **complex, production\-quality software using AI coding tools** **such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools.**

### **Global Collaboration**


* **Ability to thrive in a globally distributed engineering organization and build strong technical partnerships across teams in** **Bengaluru, the U.S., China, and Ireland****.**
* **Ability to collaborate effectively across organizational and geographic boundaries, using both synchronous and asynchronous communication to drive technical work and maintain alignment.**

  

**Additional Details**


eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India


**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18845 **Date posted** 09/15/2026
### **We Are**


Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years deep in the realities of chip design, where a power integrity issue at 3nm can cost months and millions, and you have learned that the gap between a tool that works in theory and one that closes timing on a real SoC is everything. You think in terms of deployment, not demos. You know what it takes to get an EDA solution from product spec to production use at a top semiconductor company, and you care about making that path shorter and cleaner every time.


You are comfortable sitting with a customer architect who is three weeks from tapeout, diagnosing a signal integrity failure, and walking out with a plan that actually works. You do not wait for perfect documentation. You dig into the design, ask the right questions, and move. You have worked across ASIC physical design, power or signal integrity closure, or custom circuit simulation, and you understand how those worlds connect when you are trying to ship silicon that actually functions.


At Synopsys, you will work with the Ansys EDA portfolio, deploy it at companies building the most advanced chips in the world, and help shape what the tools become next.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Deploy Synopsys Ansys EDA products at top semiconductor companies working on leading\-edge SoCs and 3DICs at 7nm, 5nm, and 3nm nodes
* Work directly with global customers, IP providers, and foundries to understand design challenges around power integrity, signal integrity, reliability (EM, ESD, thermal), advanced timing, jitter, and packaging
* Collaborate with software developers, architects, and product specialists to translate customer challenges into EDA product specifications and drive product development
* Use the Ansys Seascape platform to solve big\-data design challenges across chip, package, and system levels
* Provide expert technical guidance and consultation to customers globally, helping them close power, signal, and reliability issues on real designs
* Diagnose complex design failures, reproduce issues, and work with engineering teams to deliver solutions that hold up in production
* Travel occasionally to customer sites for deployment support, technical reviews, and design problem\-solving

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable the world's leading semiconductor companies to tape out chips at 7nm, 5nm, and 3nm by solving power, signal, and reliability challenges they cannot close without your expertise
* Shape the next generation of Synopsys Ansys EDA tools by feeding real customer pain points directly into product development
* Reduce time to closure for customers facing critical design bottlenecks, turning weeks of debug into days with the right deployment and guidance
* Build long\-term technical relationships with architects and design teams at top\-tier semiconductor companies, becoming their trusted resource for advanced node challenges
* Drive adoption of the Seascape platform across the industry, proving out its value on real, complex designs
* Influence foundry and IP provider roadmaps by surfacing design trends and tool gaps you see across multiple customer engagements
* Mentor application engineers and expand the team's collective expertise in power integrity, signal integrity, and reliability at scale

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or related field, and 5\+ years of related experience, or Master's degree with 3\+ years of experience
* Hands\-on experience in ASIC physical design, power integrity/signal integrity/reliability closure, or custom circuit design and simulation
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues in real customer design environments
* Solid programming skills in scripting languages like Python, Tcl, or Perl for automation and workflow development
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs clearly to customers and internal teams
* Willingness to travel occasionally to customer sites for deployment and technical support
* Experience with EDA tools for power analysis, signal integrity, or reliability verification is a strong plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a customer meeting with incomplete information, ask three sharp questions, and leave with a clear picture of what is actually broken and what needs to happen next
* You are comfortable context\-switching between a product development discussion in the morning and a customer debug session in the afternoon without losing the thread of either
* You push back when a product spec is too vague or a deployment plan does not account for how customers actually work, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward
* You do not need to be the loudest person in the room, but when you speak, people listen because you have done the work and you know what you are talking about
* You are organized enough to manage multiple customer engagements, product feedback loops, and internal projects at once without dropping details that matter
* You genuinely enjoy learning new technology and figuring out how to make it work in messy, real\-world conditions

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


You will be part of the Applications Engineering team deploying Synopsys Ansys EDA products globally. The team works closely with software developers, architects, product specialists, and customers at top semiconductor companies to drive product development and deployment on leading\-edge SoCs and 3DICs. Your recruiter will share more about the team structure, regional focus, and current customer engagements during the interview process.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  


At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.
